faqs.question: Do I need sales calls to upgrade?
faqs.answer: No. All plans are self-serve with flat pricing. No per-seat traps or discovery calls.

faqs.question: What happens when more apps ship?
faqs.answer: Future Vrooli Business Suite apps appear in your catalog as they become ready, with access controlled by your plan and usage credits.

faqs.question: Are replays watermarked?
faqs.answer: Free and Solo exports keep a watermark. Pro and above remove it and allow custom branding on Studio+.

faqs.question: Can I use this for testing?
faqs.answer: Yes. The same workflows can run in CI. Failures replay like a movie so you can debug in minutes.
